functions.name: delegate
functions.desc:
Ask a capable helper for help looking up a piece of information or performing an action.
Do not simply repeat what the user said as instructions.
You should use this to break up complex user queries into multiple simpler steps.
NOTE: Helpers cannot see previous parts of your conversation.

functions.name: submit_day_plan
functions.desc:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan

msg.content:
I've crafted your 5-day travel itinerary from Denver to New York featuring both Manhattan and New York City. Here's your complete plan:

## **Day 1 - March 18, 2022: Arrival in Manhattan**
- **Transportation:** Flight F3767913 from Denver to New York (Departure: 14:18, Arrival: 20:00)
- **Accommodation:** Cute 1 bdrm in shared crown heights apt w backyard ($574/night)
- **Dinner:** Kamat (Indian & French cuisine, $51 average cost)

## **Day 2 - March 19, 2022: Manhattan Exploration**
- **Breakfast:** Bake N Shake (Mexican cuisine, $10 average cost)
- **Attractions:** Top of The Rock, Rockefeller Center, Times Square
- **Lunch:** Chings Chinese (French, Mexican, Pizza, $95 average cost)
- **Dinner:** Kamat (Indian & French cuisine, $51 average cost)
- **Accommodation:** Cute 1 bdrm in shared crown heights apt w backyard ($574/night)

## **Day 3 - March 20, 2022: Manhattan Landmarks**
- **Breakfast:** Nosh Mahal (Tea, Cafe, Pizza, $51 average cost)
- **Attractions:** Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Central Park
- **Lunch:** Paranthas 21 (Desserts, Tea, French, $55 average cost)
- **Dinner:** Saravana Bhavan (Desserts, Pizza, BBQ, $93 average cost)
- **Accommodation:** Cute 1 bdrm in shared crown heights apt w backyard ($574/night)

## **Day 4 - March 21, 2022: New York City**
- **Transportation:** Taxi from Manhattan to New York (27 mins, $13)
- **Breakfast:** Bake N Shake (Mexican cuisine, $10 average cost)
- **Attractions:** Brooklyn Bridge, 9/11 Memorial & Museum, One World Observatory
- **Lunch:** Gurgaon Hights (Cafe, American, Indian, $46 average cost)
- **Dinner:** QD's Restaurant (Tea, Desserts, Indian, $93 average cost)
- **Accommodation:** A Contemporary Homelike Stay in the Best of BK ($228/night)

## **Day 5 - March 22, 2022: Departure**
- **Transportation:** Flight F3766607 from New York to Denver (Departure: 07:23, Arrival: 09:56)

## **Budget Breakdown:**
- **Flights:** $371 + $327 = $698
- **Accommodations:** $574 × 3 + $228 = $1,950
- **Dining:** Estimated $400-500 per person for the trip
- **Transportation within NYC:** $13 taxi
- **Attractions:** Varying costs for observation decks and museums

**Total Estimated Cost:** Around $3,200-3,500 for 2 people (well within your $6,300 budget!)

This itinerary includes your preferred Mexican and Indian cuisine options, major NYC attractions, and comfortable accommodations. You'll experience iconic landmarks while staying within budget with plenty of room for shopping, additional activities, or dining upgrades.
